description: RL4UC is a reinforcement-learning environment for unit commitment. States include generator commitment and demand and wind information; actions choose feasible commitment changes, followed by economic dispatch and operating-cost rewards. The provider is pwdemars (repository owner). Coverage: The environment simulates configured generator systems with stochastic demand and wind. No common geographic dataset or observation period is established by the README. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies GNU GPL version 3. Case data and other software have separate conditions. Limitations: This is an experimental decision environment associated with research papers. Independent maintenance and transfer to real-system operations were not established. For simulation it supports algorithm comparisons for generation scheduling. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly identifies RL4UC.
